title: A star less for too many clicks
body:
The user interface needs a lot to be desired. Especially when we want to edit a task. Too many clicks have a problem. 
There has to be an inbox opened when the app opens, so one can enter the task without any friction. But when one is coming from notification, the notified tsk should show up. 
there looks to be some issue about real time sync as well. 
A long note taking facility is required for Todoist. Also, a discussion among the users sharing the task. 
As we don’t know who entered the task, there is a confusion after someone who didn’t  put the task deleted it. 
Overall, a good experience and I am sticking with it though I am yet to get a good note taking app.
A bonus would be to track and report the tasks. I usually have a flow of changing the time when the task is not done. I need to know for how much longer the task was Pending.

title: [Update: 1 star changed to 5 stars!] I loved the app BUT
body:
Previous complaint:

I’ve been using this app for years. I had no intentions of switching to another to-do app. 

Unfortunately a recent update removed the traditional widget. Now I’m only getting the option of the new iOS 14 widget. 

The problem here is that I cannot mark my tasks from the home screen now. Every time I try to tick a task off from the widget, it opens the app. Now I have to tick off tasks from within the app. What’s the point of a widget if I have to go to the app every time I wanna tick off tasks?!?!?! That’s not how widgets are supposed to work. 

The previous old widget was so much better. I could tick off the tasks instantly from the home screen itself. This new update is a dealbreaker for me and I’m sorry but I’m switching apps. I hope the developers realise this issue and fix it ASAP!

UPDATE:

The developers responded, and now I can operate the widget from the home screen itself! Sending love to the Todoist team.

title: Will Change Your Life
body:
Over the years I've tried many GTD apps & workflows. Todoist, for many years now, is the only one that has scaled well from a simple todo list all the way up to managing complex projects with multi-level sub-tasks and multiple collaborators. The seamless & reliable integration into multiple platforms is outstanding. New features like karma & location-based alerts are thoughtfully added without altering existing workflow or breaking backward compatibility.

The only drawbacks of the iPhone app are that it doesn't support collapsing sub-tasks like all their other platforms & the priority bars are barely visible. Other than that & the occasionally irritating but trivial UI tweak, it does it's job brilliantly well & will help you focus on yours.
